name: Dice3D
rootCause: Similar to the previous attack on EOS.WIN on November 11, multiple contract accounts were used to send transaction requests at the same time, and the front feint account was used to implement small bets. After ensuring a higher probability for the main attack account, increase the betting amount. And then get high bonuses.

Use multiple accounts to simultaneously send transaction requests for attack, so that the last attacker account gets the highest winning rate.
